messages.author: Fabian Glaser
messages.body:
Hellow all,
I am trying to compile amber20 but has a consitent error with cuda / cmake, here the error I get, I will
CMake Error at cmake/CudaConfig.cmake:15 (message):
You turned on CUDA, but it was not found. Please set the
CUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR option to your CUDA install directory.
Did somebdoy find this problem and could give me an idea what is wrong?
THanks!

messages.author: Vinicius Wilian Cruzeiro
messages.body:
Hello Fabian,
CMake is not finding CUDA in your environment variables. Try running the cmake command adding -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=[path where you installed CUDA].
I hope this helps,
Best,
Vinícius Wilian D. Cruzeiro, PhD
Postdoctoral Researcher
Department of Chemistry
Stanford University
Twitter: .vwcruzeiro

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Nov 11, 2021, Vinicius Wilian Cruzeiro wrote:
>
>CMake is not finding CUDA in your environment variables. Try running the
>cmake command adding -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=[path where you installed
>CUDA].
I think it also works to set your CUDA_HOME environment variable, typically
to /usr/local/cuda (but choose the path that works for your machine.)
....dac
